The '''battle of the ''Corellian Queen''''' was an engagement between [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and other elements of the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] and [[New Republic Special Operations]], and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces loyal to [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]]. New Republic starfighters hidden in the hollow inside of the ersatz ''[[Corellian Queen]]'' ambushed the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] pilots who attempted to pirate the ship. Using the newly developed [[flechette torpedo]]es to attack the pilots, the New Republic forces were able to drive off and track the Imperial forces back to [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]. [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] of Rogue Squadron had his craft and [[R4-G7|assigned astromech]] severely damaged in this engagement, and his fellow Rogues [[Avan Beruss|Avan]] and [[Feylis Ardele|Feylis]] also had to eject.<ref name="Mindor" />
